headline: Hollywood’s brief thaw belies a long winter
summary: Relations between Hollywood scribes and the studios that employ them are starting to warm up. The union representing movie and TV writers tentatively agreed to a new contract on Sunday, setting the stage to end a five-month impasse. Content production is back on the budget line for streaming services. The trouble is the entertainment complex from acting to distribution is still flawed.

headline: Aspinall KOs Tybura, sets sights on UFC heavyweight title
summary: British heavyweight Tom Aspinall made a triumphant return to MMA with a devastating first-round knockout of Marcin Tybura in the main event of Saturday's UFC Fight Night at the O2 Arena, almost a year to the day after tearing his MCL.

headline: WWE, Endeavor-owned UFC to merge into $21 bln entertainment giant
summary: World Wrestling Entertainment Inc will combine with Endeavor Group-owned mixed martial arts franchise UFC to form a new, publicly listed entertainment giant valued at about $21 billion, the companies said on Monday.
